# EKS

Manage Kubernetes cluster metadata and optionally start local k3s API servers.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `eks` |
| Signing name | `eks` |
| Wire protocol | REST JSON |
| API version | `2017-11-01` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Records / optional k3s |
| Selected operations | 46 of 70 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#eks) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Records mode starts no Kubernetes API.
- k3s mode makes accepted account principals administrators; IAM authorization is not reproduced.
- Cluster data and upgrades do not persist across restart.
- No Auto Mode, Outposts, hybrid nodes or CloudWatch log delivery.
- Reset removes the k3s containers it started; a cluster starting during the reset can outlive it until shutdown.
- Enabled Auto Mode compute, block storage and load balancing requests fail explicitly; Auto Mode update blocks remain outside the profile.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
